rules: REPLACE: complete, unambiguous rules. Signal timing, entry, exit, sizing, instruments, what happens on missing data.
primary_metric: annualised Sharpe ratio of daily net returns over the forward window
pass_criteria: REPLACE: e.g. forward Sharpe > 0 AND max drawdown < 15% AND at least 20 trades; all three must hold
cost_model: REPLACE: e.g. 2 bps per unit traded, one way
data_source: REPLACE: where forward returns will come from (broker statements, exchange data)
analysis_plan: Scored with holdout-audit at the end of the window; no parameter may change during the trial; any change starts a new sealed trial.
client_reference: REPLACE: an opaque reference, not a name
